title: Use target.getLookupKey() for contstructing lookup keys for vendor mode

timeline.message: Use target.getLookupKey() for contstructing lookup keys for vendor mode
timeline.author: Yun Peng

diff.patch:
@@ -809,6 +809,14 @@ def testVendorRepoWithSymlinks(self):
         ' bar!\n',
     )
 
+  def testVendorAliasTarget(self):
+    self.ScratchFile("foo/file.txt")
+    self.ScratchFile('foo/BUILD', ['alias(name="foo", actual="file.txt")'])
+
+    # This should not fail
+    # Regression test for https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/23300
+    self.RunBazel(['vendor', '//foo/...', '--vendor_dir=vendor'])
+
 
 if __name__ == '__main__':
   absltest.main()

timeline.diff_hunk:
@@ -282,12 +281,7 @@ private BlazeCommandResult vendorTargets(
     // Traverse the graph created from build to collect repos and vendor them
     ImmutableList<SkyKey> targetKeys =
         buildResult.getActualTargets().stream()
-            .map(
-                target ->
-                    ConfiguredTargetKey.builder()
-                        .setConfigurationKey(target.getConfigurationKey())
-                        .setLabel(target.getLabel())
-                        .build())
+            .map(target -> target.getLookupKey())
